svg.title: GLeaks: consent, independent searches with a live log, results and actions

g.text: Only check identifiers that belong to you.
Profile index (28 public sites, listed in Preferences)
Sent: The name, to each site. For an email, only its hash, to Gravatar.
Returned: Which sites have a public page with this name. A page may belong…
Sent: The full identifier, as a search query.
Returned: Public pages that mention the exact identifier.
Returned: Names and details of known breaches that include the address.
Each source runs on its own. This log stays inside your encrypted profile.
Email addresses, Password hints, Passwords, Usernames
Breach data provided by Have I Been Pwned.
Change the password if you still use it
Look for sign-ins you don't recognize
